<?php
// Read n
$n = intval(trim(fgets(STDIN)));
$mod = 1000003;

// Precompute powers of 2 up to 2^n modulo mod
$pow2 = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $pow2[$i] = ($pow2[$i - 1] * 2) % $mod;
}

// Compute sum_{k=1..n} 2^{2k-1} = 2 * sum_{k=1..n} 4^{k-1}
$sum = 0;
$pow4 = 1; // 4^0
for ($k = 1; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $sum = ($sum + $pow4) % $mod;
    $pow4 = ($pow4 * 4) % $mod;
}
$sum = ($sum * 2) % $mod;

// Total cells = (2^n)^2 = 2^{2n}
$total = ($pow2[$n] * $pow2[$n]) % $mod;

// Empty cells = total - sum (mod)
$ans = $total - $sum;
if ($ans < 0) $ans += $mod;

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

}

// Compute sum_{k=1..n} 2^{k-1} * (2^k - 1) modulo mod
$sum = 0;

    $term = ($pow2[$k - 1] * (($pow2[$k] - 1 + $mod) % $mod)) % $mod;
    $sum = ($sum + $term) % $mod;
}

// Total cells in 2^n x 2^n square
$total = ($pow2[$n] * $pow2[$n]) % $mod;

// Empty cells = total - sum (mod)
$ans = ($total - $sum) % $mod;
if ($ans < 0) $ans += $mod;

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Read input
$n = intval(trim(fgets(STDIN)));
$mod = 1000003;

// Precompute powers of 2 up to 2^n modulo mod
$pow2 = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $pow2[$i] = ($pow2[$i - 1] * 2) % $mod;
}

// Compute sum_{k=1..n} 2^{k-1} * k^2 modulo mod
$sum = 0;
for ($k = 1; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $k2 = ($k * $k) % $mod;
    $term = ($pow2[$k - 1] * $k2) % $mod;
    $sum += $term;
    if ($sum >= $mod) $sum -= $mod;
}

// Total cells in 2^n x 2^n square
$total = ($pow2[$n] * $pow2[$n]) % $mod;

// Empty cells = total - sum (mod mod)
$ans = $total - $sum;
if ($ans < 0) $ans += $mod;

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Read input
$n = intval(trim(fgets(STDIN)));
$mod = 1000003;

// Precompute powers of 2 modulo mod up to 2n
$maxExp = 2 * $n;
$pow2 = array_fill(0, $maxExp + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $maxExp; $i++) {
    $pow2[$i] = ($pow2[$i - 1] * 2) % $mod;
}

// Compute sum_{k=1..n} 2^{2k-1} mod mod
$sum = 0;
for ($k = 1; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $sum += $pow2[2 * $k - 1];
    if ($sum >= $mod) $sum -= $mod;
}

// Total cells in the box: (2n)^2
$total = (4 * $n % $mod) * $n % $mod;

// Empty cells = total - sum (mod)
$ans = $total - $sum;
if ($ans < 0) $ans += $mod;

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Read n
$n = intval(trim(fgets(STDIN)));
$mod = 1000003;

// Compute 2n
$twoN = (2 * $n) % $mod;

// Compute (2n)^2 mod
$twoN2 = ($twoN * $twoN) % $mod;

// Compute n^2 mod
$n2 = ($n * $n) % $mod;

// Answer = (2n)^2 - n^2 mod
$ans = ($twoN2 - $n2) % $mod;
if ($ans < 0) $ans += $mod;

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Read input
$n = intval(trim(fgets(STDIN)));
$mod = 1000003;

// Precompute powers of 2 up to 2^n modulo mod
$p2 = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $p2[$i] = ($p2[$i - 1] * 2) % $mod;
}

// Compute sum_{k=1..n} 2^{2k-1} mod mod
$sum = 0;
for ($k = 1; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $term = ($p2[$k] * $p2[$k - 1]) % $mod; // 2^{2k-1} = 2^k * 2^{k-1}
    $sum = ($sum + $term) % $mod;
}

// Total cells in 2n x 2n box
$total = (4 * ($n % $mod) % $mod * ($n % $mod)) % $mod;

// Empty cells = total - sum (mod)
$ans = ($total - $sum) % $mod;
if ($ans < 0) $ans += $mod;

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

// Read n
$n = intval(trim(fgets(STDIN)));
$mod = 1000003;

// Precompute powers of 2 up to 2^n mod mod
$pow2 = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $pow2[$i] = ($pow2[$i - 1] * 2) % $mod;
}

// Total cells in 2^n x 2^n box
$total = ($pow2[$n] * $pow2[$n]) % $mod;

// Sum of areas of cookies placed: sum_{k=1..n} 2^{2k-1}
$sum = 0;
for ($k = 1; $k <= $n; $k++) {
    $term = ($pow2[$k] * $pow2[$k - 1]) % $mod; // 2^{2k-1}
    $sum += $term;
    if ($sum >= $mod) $sum -= $mod;
}

// Empty cells = total - sum (mod)
$ans = $total - $sum;
if ($ans < 0) $ans += $mod;

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Read input
$n = intval(trim(fgets(STDIN)));
$mod = 1000003;

// Precompute powers of 2 up to 2n
$maxK = 2 * $n;
$pow2 = array_fill(0, $maxK + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $maxK; $i++) {
    $pow2[$i] = ($pow2[$i - 1] * 2) % $mod;
}

// Compute sum_{k=1}^{2n} floor(k/2) * 2^{k-1} mod mod
$sum = 0;
for ($k = 1; $k <= $maxK; $k++) {
    $floor = intdiv($k, 2);
    if ($floor == 0) continue;
    $term = ($floor * $pow2[$k - 1]) % $mod;
    $sum += $term;
    if ($sum >= $mod) $sum -= $mod;
}

// Total cells = (2n)^2
$total = (4 * $n % $mod) * ($n % $mod) % $mod;

// Empty cells = total - sum (mod)
$ans = $total - $sum;
$ans %= $mod;
if ($ans < 0) $ans += $mod;

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

Write a program in PHP to solve this programming problem:
Description: Fangy collects cookies. Once he decided to take a box and put cookies into it in some way. If we take a square k × k in size, divided into blocks 1 × 1 in size and paint there the main diagonal together with cells, which lie above it, then the painted area will be equal to the area occupied by one cookie k in size. Fangy also has a box with a square base 2n × 2n, divided into blocks 1 × 1 in size. In a box the cookies should not overlap, and they should not be turned over or rotated. See cookies of sizes 2 and 4 respectively on the figure:    To stack the cookies the little walrus uses the following algorithm. He takes out of the repository the largest cookie which can fit in some place in the box and puts it there. Everything could be perfect but alas, in the repository the little walrus has infinitely many cookies of size 2 and larger, and there are no cookies of size 1, therefore, empty cells will remain in the box. Fangy wants to know how many empty cells will be left in the end.
Input Specification: The first line contains a single integer n (0 ≤ n ≤ 1000).
Output Specification: Print the single number, equal to the number of empty cells in the box. The answer should be printed modulo 106 + 3.

Sample Input:
3
Sample Output:
9

Notes: NoteIf the box possesses the base of 23 × 23 (as in the example), then the cookies will be put there in the following manner: 
Take input from standard input and output to standard output
Provide the PHP code without any extra description or tokens. Target code:
